## Notes

### Changelog Sections Explained

- **Features**: New functionality added (commits starting with `feat:`)
- **Bug Fixes**: Issues resolved (commits starting with `fix:`)
- **Documentation**: Documentation updates (commits starting with `docs:`)
- **Other Changes**: Refactoring, tests, style changes, etc.
- **Full Commit History**: Complete list of all commits since last release

### Commit Message Convention

To get properly categorized changelogs, use conventional commit format:

```
feat: Add new feature
fix: Fix a bug
docs: Update documentation
test: Add or update tests
refactor: Refactor code
style: Code style changes
chore: Maintenance tasks
```

### Benefits

- ✅ Automatic generation on every release
- ✅ Organized by commit type
- ✅ Includes author names and commit hashes
- ✅ Shows test results and build status
- ✅ Provides download and usage instructions
- ✅ Downloadable as a file from GitHub releases
